title: Caskade – One library for all your games
description: An open-source game library and launcher for Linux, Windows and macOS. Organise store games, emulators and web games, and sync saves and playtime across your PCs.
intro: Store games, emulators, web games and the other PCs in your house, all one press from playing.
heroNote: Free and open source · Works offline · No account or telemetry
sourcesIntro: Finds games across your existing libraries
featuresTitle: Every store, emulator and PC in one place
featuresIntro: Caskade discovers your games, links the PCs in your house and sets up emulators for older platforms.
libraryBody: Caskade scans your launchers, store accounts and folders automatically. It pulls in cover art and game details and merges duplicate copies into a single entry.
householdBody: Pair your PCs to keep your library, saves and playtime in sync over your local network. Copy a game between machines, or stream it from another room.
retroBody: Point Caskade at your ROM folders or a RomM server. It installs and configures the right emulators and lists your ROMs alongside your PC games.
principlesTitle: Your library stays on your devices
principlesIntro: There is no Caskade cloud or required account. Nothing installs, updates or shares without your confirmation.
offlineBody: Browse and launch installed games without an internet connection. Paired devices sync directly over your local network.
privacyBody: Caskade requires no account and includes no telemetry or ads. Store sign-ins are kept in your operating system's keychain.
customBody: Restyle the interface with themes, extend it with plugins, or switch to console mode for full controller support on a TV or handheld.
downloadIntro: Pick your platform. Caskade is free, open source and updates itself.
linuxBody: The platform where every feature is developed and tested. Built for desktop Linux, including gamescope.
windowsBody: Authenticode-signed Windows installer and app. Launching, streaming and sync are tested on Windows; some real-hardware checks remain.
macBody: Signed and notarized by Apple for Apple silicon and Intel Macs. Some real-hardware checks remain.
faqAccountAnswer: No Caskade account is needed. Your library stays on your devices. You can connect existing store accounts to import games you own, including games you have not installed yet.
faqStores: Does this replace Steam or my other launchers?
faqStoresAnswer: Caskade lists your games in one place and starts them through the right launcher, emulator or program. Games that need a store launcher still use it. Caskade sells nothing and adds no DRM.
faqController: Can I use it from the couch?
faqControllerAnswer: Yes. Console mode has larger cards, controller navigation and an on-screen keyboard. It starts automatically under gamescope, or you can switch it on in settings.
faqContributeAnswer: Try a build, report a problem, translate a string, make a theme or contribute code. Caskade is open source under the MIT licence.
issuesLink: Find an issue to work on.
footerNote: Open-source game library for Linux, Windows and macOS.
